item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is pretty short, but since it's listed on the hub as a Prologue, it doesn't need to be super long. It works well to set things up and introduce the various concepts that we'll be dealing with the rest of the series.

I can't however bring myself to upvote this, because it doesn't make usage of one of the better elements of the Hand format, which is the presence of multiple interlocutors to provide different viewpoints. This only has a single person leaving footnotes, and only two of them. It doesn't have enough character to be effective for me. Novoting.
